w4i5MCdYzVA.description:
This one moment in time, changed the course of our lives for the next 5 years..

With our soon to be return to these beautiful lands with some friends this summer we thought this would be the perfect Monday Memories. This time from the very first time we ever discovered Van Life! Our first ever road trip back in 2020 to Scotland. One that left lifetime impressions on all of us! Funny story: We had spend the new year period this year in Edinburgh in an Airbnb. On that trip we met a couple of subscribers that follow this channel who told us all about the incredible road trip called the North Coast 500 or NC500. We had never heard of this but they sold it so well to us that we decided then and there we would do it at some point that year. Then 2020 happened and those plans had to be postponed. But the second we could all move again in the July that year we rented a motorhome (our first ever) and we left for the Highlands! A road trip that still to this day we all talk about, being one of our best ever! Not to mention the start of our obsession with van life and traveling by road. The last 5 years of our lives might have been very different had we not have bumped into those subscribers on that day in Edinburgh. Theres no other place like the Highlands of Scotland. You need to visit it and experience it to know but needless to say, we are very much looking forward to seeing even more of it this summer!
